requirements.text: Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated experience shipping production web applications as part of an engineering team, including both user-facing interfaces and the services behind them.
Demonstrated experience building and running applications on Microsoft Azure, including at least one production workload using Azure AI services.

Hands-on experience with the Azure AI platform — Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure AI Foundry — used to build a retrieval-augmented or natural-language application that real users depend on. Depth here is a primary requirement of this role.
Working command of the surrounding Azure stack: compute, storage, managed databases, secrets, and Microsoft Entra ID as a consumer of it.
Proficiency in Python, and strong skills in TypeScript with a modern frontend framework.
REST API design, and strong SQL against relational databases and cloud data platforms.
Practical understanding of AI application patterns — RAG, embeddings and vector search, semantic layers, tool calling, evaluation, and grounding.
Strong Git and collaborative development practice, including CI/CD and written documentation.
Ability to work in an unfamiliar codebase and cloud environment: read it, extend it safely, and document what you find.
Comfort in an early-stage, start-up-style team — owning work independently and shaping process where none exists yet.
Experience at a start-up, or on a founding or early-stage product team.
Azure certification — Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Developer Associate, or equivalent.
Experience building a centralized knowledge platform, internal data portal, or enterprise search product, including permission-aware retrieval.
Experience with semantic or metric layers over a data warehouse.
Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SharePoint and Microsoft Graph, or embedding BI content such as Tableau or Power BI with row- and role-level security.
Interest in or experience with sports business — ticketing, partnerships, marketing, or analytics.
